text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-senpai! Here, this is your birthday 
present!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Waaow! Thank you very very much! What is 
this inside the present?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A tape measure! One that supports the 
imperial system!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I had a feeling you'd love it, 
Taiki-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We're milersâwe live not for the 1600m, 
but for the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! Growing up in America, this is 
definitely the way to go, *yes*!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I was always struggling to convert 
meters in my head...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is the best birthday present ever! 
Thank you, Gran!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Taiki-senpai, shall we head out 
right away to measure our miles?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I brought my own tape measure along too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nice idea! This looks like it's going to 
be lots of fun, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Gran
text_block_list.text: Miles are the best! Miles are awesome!
